:::{#cor-hazard-ratio-vs-baseline}

#### Hazard factor from difference of log-hazard from baseline

$$\hazfactor(t|\vx)= \expf{\diffloghaz(t|\vx)}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof

This derivation uses @cor-hazard-ratio-diffloghaz.

$$
\ba
\hazfactor(t|\vx)
&\eqdef \hr(t| \vx : \vzero) && \text{(definition of hazard factor)}
\\
&= \expf{\diffloghaz(t|\vx : \vzero)} && \text{(applying the hazard-ratio corollary with } \vxs = \vzero\text{)}
\\
&= \expf{\diffloghaz(t|\vx)} && \text{(shorthand notation for log-hazard difference from baseline)}
\ea
$$

:::
